academic_prerequisite_rules.subject: Programming
academic_prerequisite_rules.message: Foundational programming proficiency is critical for Software Engineering roles.
academic_prerequisite_rules.remedy: Strengthen core programming paradigms (OOP, memory management, and recursion) through supplementary coding practice.

academic_prerequisite_rules.subject: Mathematics & Statistics
academic_prerequisite_rules.message: Mathematical foundation (Linear Algebra, Calculus, and Probability) is essential for machine learning algorithms.
academic_prerequisite_rules.remedy: Review applied statistics and linear algebra concepts through targeted academic tutorials.

academic_prerequisite_rules.subject: Networking
academic_prerequisite_rules.message: Understanding TCP/IP, OSI layers, routing, and DNS is mandatory before mastering penetration testing and threat defense.
academic_prerequisite_rules.remedy: Complete hands-on Wireshark packet capture labs and revise network protocol fundamentals.

academic_prerequisite_rules.subject: Operating Systems & Architecture
academic_prerequisite_rules.message: Operating systems fundamentals (processes, threads, POSIX, memory management) underpin containerization and virtualization.
academic_prerequisite_rules.remedy: Engage in Linux kernel/bash scripting and process management exercises.

academic_prerequisite_rules.subject: Human Computer Interaction & Design
academic_prerequisite_rules.message: HCI heuristics, cognitive load principles, and usability standards are foundational for product design.
academic_prerequisite_rules.remedy: Revisit Nielsen Norman Group heuristics and conduct structured usability walkthroughs.

competency_dependency_rules.message: Writing automated unit and integration tests requires foundational OOP knowledge.
Building automated CI/CD deployment pipelines requires understanding container builds and Dockerfiles.
Feature engineering and data preparation in Pandas/NumPy are required before training scikit-learn models.
Security auditing tools and exploits execute primarily in Linux environments (Kali Linux, Bash).
Effective high-fidelity prototyping requires user journey mapping and empathy research inputs.

portfolio_and_readiness_rules.message: No practical projects recorded in portfolio. Industry hiring heavily favors concrete project evidence.
portfolio_and_readiness_rules.recommendation: Build at least 2 hands-on projects aligned with your target career track.

portfolio_and_readiness_rules.message: Curriculum Vitae (CV) has not yet been uploaded for profile verification.
portfolio_and_readiness_rules.recommendation: Upload an up-to-date CV in the Document Management portal to validate credentials.

portfolio_and_readiness_rules.message: Current weekly study allocation is limited relative to the identified skill gaps.
portfolio_and_readiness_rules.recommendation: Consider allocating at least 10–12 hours weekly, or extend your roadmap target horizon across multiple academic semesters.
